The '''Sivorian Sea''' was a vast [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sivoria]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The ocean was famous for its deep, emerald-green [[Water/Legends|waters]].<ref name="JH" />
